_comment: The gateway this maintenance line is tested against, and therefore the
only one it supports. Read by deploy/ci/e2e-stack.sh (the e2e-integration
job in ci.yml) and by frontend/cypress.config.integration.ts.
It has the same shape as the file of this name on main, so the supported
range is derived the same way on both lines: the lowest and the highest
`version` among the lanes with required=true. Here that is 0.0.116 only.
Images are pinned as tag@digest: the tag is for readers, the digest is
what gets pulled. sandbox_image is the workload image the specs create
sandboxes from; it publishes no version tags, so only the digest names it.
Do not add a 0.1.x lane and do not move `sdk` (the pin in backend/go.mod).
This SDK is the last one that names the workspace the way gateway 0.0.116
reads it (a plain `workspace` string). The next SDK, 90dbe545, sends a
typed selector in a different field; 0.0.116 does not know that field and
ignores it WITHOUT AN ERROR, so every sandbox, provider and policy call
runs in `default` whatever workspace was asked for. Dashboard 0.3.0 has
that SDK and must not be used with 0.0.116. Gateways from 0.1.0 on reject
this SDK (`workspace_scope is required`); they are served by main (1.x).

lanes.label: 0.0.116, the only gateway this line supports
